import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAXN = 210;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        FlowEdge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static List<FlowEdge>[] g = new List[MAXN];
    static int[] lvl = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAXN];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        g[u].add(new FlowEdge(v, c, g[v].size()));
        g[v].add(new FlowEdge(u, 0, g[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void bfs(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        lvl[s] = 0;
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (FlowEdge e : g[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[e.to] < 0) {
                    lvl[e.to] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
        if (u == t) return f;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            FlowEdge e = g[u].get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[u] < lvl[e.to]) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    g[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            bfs(s);
            if (lvl[t] < 0) return flow;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
    }

    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static int N, T, src, dst;
    static int[][] cap = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] sci = new int[15][15];
    static int[][][] grid = new int[65][15][15];
    static boolean[][] seen = new boolean[15][15];
    static boolean[][][][][] ok = new boolean[65][15][15][15][15];

    static int idx(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x-1)*N + y + k*N*N;
    }

    static void propagate(int sx, int sy, int x, int y, int step) {
        seen[x][y] = true;
        ok[step][sx][sy][x][y] = true;
        if (step >= T || grid[step][x][y] != 0) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > N || ny > N) continue;
            if (seen[nx][ny] || grid[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            propagate(sx, sy, nx, ny, step + 1);
        }
    }

    static void setup() {
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= N; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= N; ++y) {
                    if (grid[t-1][x][y] != 0) {
                        grid[t][x][y] = grid[t-1][x][y];
                    } else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > N || ny > N) continue;
                            if (grid[t-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                grid[t][x][y] = 2;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= N; ++x) {
                        Arrays.fill(seen[x], false);
                    }
                    propagate(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= N; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= N; ++y) {
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= N; ++xx) {
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= N; ++yy) {
                            ok[t][x][y][xx][yy] = ok[t][x][y][xx][yy] || ok[t-1][x][y][xx][yy];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    sci[i][j] = c - '0';
                } else if (c == 'Y') {
                    grid[0][i][j] = 1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    grid[0][i][j] = 2;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    cap[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        src = N*N*2;
        dst = src - 1;
        setup();

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    addEdge(src, idx(i,j,0), sci[i][j]);
                }
                if (cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    addEdge(idx(i,j,1), dst, cap[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= N; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= N; ++y) {
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= N; ++xx) {
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= N; ++yy) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && cap[xx][yy] != 0 && ok[T][x][y][xx][yy]) {
                            addEdge(idx(x,y,0), idx(xx,yy,1), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic(src, dst));
    }
}
